_about: Our corrections to Open Opus (docs/classical-plan.md, decision 1 in section 6, and section 9.1).
Kept apart from Open Opus's own data, so build_data.py can apply them to any newer dump and say which no longer apply.
composer = Open Opus's complete_name; title = Open Opus's title exactly, outer spaces trimmed.
Applied in this order: retitle, searchterms, add; then repeated entries are dropped (same words in title and subtitle, same genre).

wikidata: Wikidata's facts (wikidata_works.json, section 10) we leave out: item = the Q id, drop = its fields (inc, prem, pub, instr), when Wikidata has them wrong. Reported stale once Wikidata no longer has them.
